430: After more than 30 years on the bike, travelling to international Trial, XC, Enduro and other races – with our exhibition show or as racers – we've realised that fitness alone won't bring you success. Technique is what takes you to the top in a race. This applies without exception to amateur riders and beginners too, who would rather count kilometres ridden than hours trained off-road. Our mission is to make the time that pros and amateurs devote to technical bike skills more enjoyable.
